correctness.rationale: For any integer h>=0 and v>0 the periodic finite-rank leaf Gaussian process has an exact one-point posterior. With true child prior C=mI_2, Gaussian conditioning yields a rational update factor (1+jv)/(1+(j+1)v) at each level; induction establishes the root variance and estimate. Independent normal coordinates give exact unconditional MSE and Gaussian interval coverage. Proof handles h=0, positive denominators, all finite h; 2268 rational assertions corroborate.
